cands.name: Adam Botana
cands.bio: Republican incumbent. Vice president of his family's Bay Water boat club in Bonita Springs; prior food-service and carnival-industry work. Born 1984 in Naples. In the House since 2020; Majority Chief Floor Whip 2022-2024; chairs a natural-resources subcommittee.
cands.local_ties: Bonita Springs resident, born in Naples (House bio, Sparker's Soapbox).

record.text: Sponsored HB 103 (2026), which would end most local business taxes; passed the House 82-26.
Sponsored HB 4005, signed by Gov. DeSantis in April 2026, making all five Naples Airport Authority seats countywide elected.
Backed an agricultural-enclave development bill, enacted as SB 686 and signed April 2026; it creates a streamlined process to certify farmland surrounded by development.

money_notes.text: Campaign raised $123,400, with $44,500 of the contributions from political committees. He chairs two committees, Boatwashers for Botana and Conservatives for Clean Water, which have raised about $2.2 million combined ($552,216 left), per Sparker's Soapbox summary of Division of Elections filings.

cands.gaps: No controversies verified. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
